findings.message: CSS declaration `transition: background 0.2s ease` runs on the browser clock and cannot be seeked deterministically across render workers.
findings.fixHint: Keep the class or attribute swap for state; put the visual change on the paused GSAP timeline.

findings.message: #bg-music has data-volume="0.28" (-11.1 dB) and a GSAP tween on `volume`. Tween values are absolute: they REPLACE this gain rather than scale it, so wherever the tween names a value the clip plays at that value, not at -11.1 dB.
findings.fixHint: Write the tween's targets in the same absolute gain (e.g. `volume: 1.95`, not `volume: 1`), or reset data-volume to 1 and let the tween carry the level on its own.

findings.message: "#mac-switch .switch-thumb" has CSS `transform: translateX(20px)` and a GSAP tween animates x. GSAP will overwrite the full CSS transform, discarding any translateX(-50%) centering or CSS scale value.
findings.fixHint: Remove `transform: translateX(20px)` from CSS and replace with GSAP properties: x: 20. Example: tl.fromTo('#mac-switch .switch-thumb', { x: 20 }, { x: 20, ...yourAnimation }). tl.fromTo is exempt from this rule.

findings.message: This HTML composition file has 368 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.

findings.message: <div id="scene-1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div id="hook-badge">. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="scene-1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
